subject: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluefinhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Hi Anna —

Great to hear BlueFin is ready to move to a short POC. Suggested agenda for the kickoff: introductions, success criteria alignment (what "good" looks like), network & data prep, timeline/milestones, and owners.

Quick asks so we can lock a 60–75 minute kickoff next week:
- Please confirm the primary technical owner for the POC (eng lead who will join SE sessions) and procurement contact for contract/PO questions.
- Any mandatory security or legal attendees we should invite? (we can include your security contact as a short agenda item)
- Your availability windows (PST preferred) for 60–75 min slots on June 23–25. If those don't work, propose alternatives.

I've attached a one-pager with suggested success criteria and a rough MVP timeline to make the first call productive. Dev (cc) will run the technical portion. Marissa will shadow for onboarding and success plan. Grace will handle billing/ops questions if procurement joins.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf, POC-mvp-timeline.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kal@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluefinhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@bluefinhealth.com>, Sophie Park <sophie.park@bluefinhealth.com>, BlueFin Security <security@bluefinhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Hi Karthik —

Thanks, that agenda looks good. Quick answers:
- Technical owner: Tom Reed (Lead Platform Engineer) — he'll join the technical deep-dive and owns test data access.
- Procurement: Sophie Park (contracts@bluefinhealth.com) — she'll need a short call to confirm PO timing.
- Security: adding security@bluefinhealth.com to the thread; they typically require SOC2 summary and a short 15-min pre-scan before the kickoff.

Availability (PST) for a 60–75 min kickoff:
- Tue June 22 after 1:00pm
- Wed June 23 9:00–11:30am
- Thu June 24 10:00–12:00pm or 3:00–5:00pm

If you need earlier slots, we can shift but prefer these. Also note procurement is out Thursday morning — Sophie can do Thursday afternoon.

I'll confirm with Tom and Sophie and loop back by EOD.

— Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Product | BlueFin Health
anna.lopez@bluefinhealth.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluefinhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Thanks Anna — tagging a couple of technical pre-reqs so Tom has visibility: 
- We'll need a small sample (S3 link or anonymized CSV) and a short schema doc before the first SE session. If there are PHI concerns, we can run the POC in a private VPC option; please let us know.
- Network: outbound to our inference endpoints (443) and a rule to allow response streaming is preferred. I can send a short checklist.
- For the SOC2/security ask I attached the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; security team, please let us know any additional evidence your team needs.

Proposed kickoff: Thu June 24 at 10:30am PST (60–75 min). That matches Anna's window and gives us a couple of days to exchange sample data. If that works, I can send the calendar invite and pre-read.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
From: BlueFin Security <security@bluefinhealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Hi all —

We reviewed the SOC2 summary you sent. Before a full kickoff we need a 15-min security pre-scan to confirm network topology and data handling for the POC. We can do a quick call Tue June 22 at 1:15pm PST (we reserve 30 minutes in case of follow-ups).

Also note procurement will require a minimal DPA/terms addendum; Sophie will flag items during the procurement call. If Redwood can provide a short list of standard contract exhibits ahead of time it speeds review.

Thanks,
BlueFin Security Team
security@bluefinhealth.com

Subject: Re: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Hi Karthik/Marissa —

Quick update from procurement: we need a short call to confirm PO timing and the trial terms before we commit to starting. I can do Tue June 22 at 2:00pm PST (30 min) or Thu June 24 at 11:30am PST. I see the security pre-scan is Tue 1:15pm — I suggest we keep the procurement call at 2:00pm on the 22nd so both security and procurement are satisfied before the kickoff.

If Redwood has a standard trial/order form and the small DPA exhibit, please send them into the thread (we use a tight review cycle but having docs ahead helps).

— Sophie

Subject: Re: BlueFin POC: availability sync, owners, and success criteria

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Security pre-scan: Tue Jun 22, 1:15pm PST (30 min) — Security to confirm network/data checklist (action: BlueFin Security).
2) Procurement touchpoint: Tue Jun 22, 2:00pm PST (30 min) — Sophie and Redwood (Marissa) to confirm trial terms and PO timing (action: Sophie/Sales Ops).
3) POC kickoff: Thu Jun 24, 10:30am PST (75 min) — Owner mapping: Tom (BlueFin technical owner); Dev (Redwood SE, technical run); Karthik (AE, business objectives); Marissa (onboarding & success plan); Grace (billing/ops).
4) Pre-kickoff artifacts: BlueFin to provide a small sample dataset or anonymized CSV and schema by end of Wed Jun 23. Redwood to circulate the calendar invite, pre-read (agenda + success criteria PDF), and a short contract exhibit for procurement (action: Karthik/Marissa).

Attachments I am sending into the thread: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and a draft trial exhibit (attached as POC-trial-exhibit.docx). I will also create the calendar invite for Thu 6/24 10:30am PST and share the Drive link.

If any of the time slots below become blocked, please reply-all with a conflict and propose up to two alternatives. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
